text:
incident-bot: Page fired — CRITICAL — host gpu-node-104 (us-west-2a) kernel panic / kubelet NotReady. PagerDuty incident: PD12345

pagerduty: Incident PD12345 created, urgency: high. Routing to schedule: infra-oncall.

marta: acked — taking it. Looking at serial console now. /cc @aj

aj: on my way, grabbing SSH and serial. Any customer-visible alerts?

marta: Prometheus shows node kubelet down and ~20 pods in CrashLoopBackOff on gpu-node-104. API latency spike in us-west-2: 502 errors around 09:05 UTC.

lee: saw 502s from hosted-api - looks like requests were being routed off the node but some LB targets still failing health checks.

sanjay: Past 5m errors: 3 customer tenants with elevated error rates (tenant-a, tenant-c, tenant-logistics). I've opened a ticket in support.

marta: serial console dump:
```
[  123.456789] Kernel panic - not syncing: Fatal exception
Call Trace:
  show_stack+0x45/0x80
  panic+0x101/0x220
  ? process_one_work+0x???
```

marta: kubelet status:
```
$ kubectl get nodes gpu-node-104 -o wide
STATUS   ROLES    AGE   VERSION
NotReady  gpu     12d   v1.26.3
```

aj: grabbing logs from kubelet:
```
journalctl -u kubelet -n 200 --no-pager | tail -n 50
Jun 10 09:04:58 kernel: NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:65:00): 79, pid=12345
```

sanjay: Xid 79 often points to GPU driver hangs. Could be NVLink or power anomaly.

marta: plan: 1) cordon + drain node if it comes back in Degraded; 2) fallback rollouts for affected services; 3) coordinate Dedicated customers for SLA impact; 4) begin host repro with infra team.

lee: temporary mitigation: set LB to remove unhealthy targets and failover to us-west-2b/c. Rolling internal feature flags to reduce load on embeddings pipeline.

marta: executing cordon+drain now (if node becomes schedulable). Command queued:
```
kubectl cordon gpu-node-104 && kubectl drain gpu-node-104 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force
```

pagerduty: PD12345 acknowledged by marta at 2026-06-10T09:07:12Z

aj: serial shows kernel panic, host didn't reboot automatically. Opening infra pager: PD-INFRA-82. Tagging @eng-sre.

ops-bot: Started runbook 'host-kernel-panic' for gpu-node-104. Steps:
- collect serial logs
- attempt safe reboot
- check BMC/IPMI
- escalate to hardware team if reboot fails

marta: @sanjay can you confirm which hosted customers had requests routed to this node? Need list for impact email.

sanjay: pulled LB logs, affected backend instances had traffic from tenant-a (id: ta-33), tenant-c (tc-7), internal-eval-runner. I'll paste CSV after.

lee: Summary for incident notes: root cause in progress — likely GPU driver/host panic. Customer impact: transient 502s, some requests retried successfully, no data loss reported. SLA window being assessed.

aj: I can try IPMI reboot now: `ipmitool -I lanplus -H bmc-gpu104 -U admin -P **** chassis power cycle`

marta: Go for it. We'll monitor for node coming back. If not responsive in 5m, start replacement workflow.

aj: IPMI cycle returned OK, host is powering off. Rebooting...

marta: good. I'll update PD and support. Creating incident ticket: https://incidents.redwood.internal/PD12345

sanjay: shared impacted-tenant list in the incident ticket and pinged support to proactively notify tenant ops.

ops-bot: PD12345 status: acknowledged -> in_progress. Next escalation timer set for 10m.

aj: Host came up, kernel shows previous panic on boot. Kubelet back but node NotReady briefly then Ready after kubelet restart.

marta: running quick health checks on pods and GPU drivers. `nvidia-smi` looks normal, NVML reports no ECC errors. Monitoring for Xid recurrence.

lee: LBs now show zero unhealthy targets in us-west-2a. API 5xx rate returning to baseline.

marta: moving to post-incident steps: collect logs, run a repro job on staging to try cause, schedule hardware diagnostic for that physical host, update runbook with Xid-79 guidance.

aj: handing off to night oncall: @lee you'll take follow-up. I'll add notes in the ticket and leave slack channel.

lee: ack — taking the handoff. If we see Xid 79 again, escalate to hardware and consider GPU replacement.

marta: thanks all. Closing PD when follow-ups are set. :thumbsup:

pagerduty: PD12345 resolved by marta at 2026-06-10T09:42:01Z
